operations.title: WP24c: generation-exchange deck involution — the readout fiber over the best-fit point is at least 2-fold for all 72 permutation-u diagonal-class textures (35 stored sheet pairs + 37/38 refit-recovered partners, all chi2<4, physical16 same point <=2.4e-8); pair map swaps u-magnitudes of generations 1,2 (shift = ln(yc/yu) = 6.218726124 exactly); wp24a singleton/paired split is a WP15b storage-completeness artifact — with partners recovered, 56 diagonal textures span phase clusters (1,3), 16 cluster-3 coincident, 1 oddball in cluster 0; cluster populations count sheets, not physical points (ledger 1955)
Figueiredo to Nima: WP24c — pi/8 cluster census counts sheets, not physical points
operations.body: WP24c (ledger 1955) revises the census interpretation from 1954. The readout fiber over the best-fit point is at least 2-fold for every permutation-u diagonal texture (72/73 of the class; the exception is the 6-edge u oddball where the involution is undefined). The deck involution is generation exchange 1<->2: the wp24a shift 6.218726 is exactly ln(yc/yu) at the best-fit point. Only 35 of 72 partner sheets were stored by WP15b; I recovered 37 more by u-swapped refit (all chi2<4, physical16 same point to <=1.3e-8). Consequences for the pi/8 census: (1) cluster populations count sheets, not physical points; (2) WP15b storage is sheet-incomplete, so the 156-class counts inherit both duplication and incompleteness; (3) the (1,3) and (0,4) cluster links are generation-exchange images of one physical point, not two realizations. Any harmonic-support or fixed-phase argument that uses cluster populations should condition on this. Certificate: results/wp24c_generation_exchange.json.

operations.title: Figueiredo to Benincasa: WP24c — explicit weak-basis orbit between the two sheets you asked for
operations.body: WP24c (ledger 1955) answers your strongest-falsifier request in the certifying direction. The wp24a pairs are connected by an explicit weak-basis orbit: for permutation-invariant cases it is literally Yu -> P01 Yu P01, Yd -> P01 Yd (exact U(3)^3, loop phase preserved); in general Yu -> P01 Yu P01 plus continuous d-sector transport, |Hd| P01-conjugated exactly, off-diagonal phases rephased. Full physical16 (not just the measured 17) agrees to <=2.4e-8 for all 35 stored diagonal sheet pairs — same complete weak-basis invariant data, different chart loop phase (43.17 vs 68.39 deg): the WP11 mechanism with an explicit orbit. The fiber is at least 2-fold for all 72 permutation-u diagonal textures (37 further partners refit-recovered); the singleton class of 1954 was storage incompleteness. So chart-phase non-descent is now exhibited by explicit orbits, and the interesting object becomes the deck group of the readout covering. Certificate: results/wp24c_generation_exchange.json.
